3. **Merchant account front** — A phantom sushi branch processing €187,400/month (30× the local average) at 3 AM with zero chargebacks and 89% foreign card issuers.

4. **Trade-based over-invoicing** — Steel ingots billed at +77% above HS reference price with fabricated Maersk-mimic BL numbers, feeding a BVI pass-through entity.

5. **The three-sentence examiner framing** — "Distance, commercial sense, whole-chain analysis" — paired with the cross-case indicator summary card tying all four typologies together.

Every workpaper has concrete amounts, storefront labels, sequencing, and detection keys. Anonymized throughout, FATF-style. Should work clean for the dry-run. Good luck this morning.
